title: Canal bridge. (Railroad bridge over the Erie Canal.) (NYPL b11707980-G91F126 020F)
blurb: * Includes one hand-colored view. Includes views by F. B. Clench, C. A. Stacey, Plimpton and other photographers and publishers. Robert Dennis Collection of Stereoscopic Views. Title devised by cataloger. Views in Lockport and vicinity, N.Y.: cityscapes, interior views, views of the Erie canal including the locks, canal boats and bridges over the canal, boys in military style uniform, a firemen's parade and other street views.
cond: Rectified 2026. Halves registered to 0.16% vertical error and 0.0° of rotation. Depth measured gentle (0.47% of frame width); hung in the VR Parlor at full size.
